name: grid-fragment-matching-vertical-rl
derivation: The frames, grid, and all items use vertical-rl: inline coordinates increase downward and block coordinates increase leftward. Logical columns 41/82 become physical heights at y20/61 on frame 1 and y170/211 on frame 2. The first frame's block-start is its right edge x10+73=83; the 17px first row occupies x83-17=66. Row 2 forces a break, suppressing the interrupted 5px row gap. Frame 2's right edge is x110+73=183, so its 23px second row occupies x160. The first grid fragment fills physical width73; the final fragment is physical width23. Both have physical height123.
